title: 删除被覆盖区间
summary: 若区间完全包含于另一区间则删除，返回最终剩余区间数量。
insight: 按左端点升序、右端点降序排序后，覆盖者一定先出现；扫描维护此前最大右端点，当前右端不超过它即被覆盖，否则成为新保留区间。
pitfalls: 相同左端点要让较长区间排前

solutions.title: 左升右降扫描
solutions.idea: 用最大右端点判断当前区间是否已被此前区间覆盖。
steps: 按 start 升序，start 相同按 end 降序排序
扫描 interval；若 end>maximumEnd 则 remaining++ 并更新 maximumEnd，否则跳过，返回 remaining

code.java: class Solution { public int removeCoveredIntervals(int[][] intervals){Arrays.sort(intervals,(a,b)->a[0]==b[0]?Integer.compare(b[1],a[1]):Integer.compare(a[0],b[0]));int maximumEnd=Integer.MIN_VALUE,remaining=0;for(int[] interval:intervals)if(interval[1]>maximumEnd){remaining++;maximumEnd=interval[1];}return remaining;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun removeCoveredIntervals(intervals:Array<IntArray>):Int{intervals.sortWith(compareBy<IntArray>{it[0]}.thenByDescending{it[1]});var maximumEnd=Int.MIN_VALUE;var remaining=0;for(interval in intervals)if(interval[1]>maximumEnd){remaining++;maximumEnd=interval[1]};return remaining} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: int removeCoveredIntervals(vector<vector<int>>& intervals){sort(intervals.begin(),intervals.end(),[](auto& a,auto& b){return a[0]!=b[0]?a[0]<b[0]:a[1]>b[1];});int maximumEnd=INT_MIN,remaining=0;for(auto& interval:intervals)if(interval[1]>maximumEnd){++remaining;maximumEnd=interval[1];}return remaining;} };
